ability.en: She has the ability to solve difficult problems under pressure.
ability.zh: 她有在压力下解决难题的能力。

absorb.en: Plants absorb carbon dioxide and release oxygen.
absorb.zh: 植物吸收二氧化碳并释放氧气。

abstract.en: The concept of beauty is quite abstract and hard to define.
abstract.zh: 美这个概念相当抽象，难以定义。

academic.en: His academic performance improved greatly this semester.
academic.zh: 他这学期的学习成绩进步很大。

accept.en: She was glad to accept the invitation to the party.
accept.zh: 她很高兴接受聚会的邀请。

accompany.en: Her friend will accompany her to the hospital.
accompany.zh: 她的朋友将陪她去医院。

accurate.en: The weather forecast is not always accurate.
accurate.zh: 天气预报并不总是准确的。

accuse.en: They accuse him of stealing the company secret.
accuse.zh: 他们指控他窃取了公司的秘密。

achieve.en: You can achieve your goals through hard work.
achieve.zh: 通过努力工作你可以实现自己的目标。

acknowledge.en: He refused to acknowledge his own mistakes.
acknowledge.zh: 他拒绝承认自己的错误。

acquire.en: It takes years to acquire a new language.
acquire.zh: 掌握一门新语言需要多年时间。

adapt.en: Animals must adapt to changes in their environment.
adapt.zh: 动物必须适应环境的变化。

adequate.en: Make sure you get adequate sleep before the exam.
adequate.zh: 考试前一定要保证充足的睡眠。

adjust.en: You can adjust the height of the chair easily.
adjust.zh: 你可以轻松调整椅子的高度。

admire.en: I deeply admire her courage and honesty.
admire.zh: 我深深钦佩她的勇气和诚实。

admit.en: He had to admit that he was wrong.
admit.zh: 他不得不承认自己错了。

adopt.en: The family decided to adopt a child from abroad.
adopt.zh: 这家人决定从国外领养一个孩子。

advance.en: Technology continues to advance at a rapid pace.

advantage.en: Speaking two languages gives you a big advantage.
advantage.zh: 会说两种语言给你带来很大优势。

advocate.en: Many teachers advocate less homework and more practice.
advocate.zh: 许多老师主张少布置作业、多做练习。

ambition.en: Her ambition is to become a professional doctor.
ambition.zh: 她的志向是成为一名职业医生。

amount.en: He spent a large amount of money on books.

analyze.en: Scientists analyze the data before drawing conclusions.
analyze.zh: 科学家在得出结论之前先分析数据。

anniversary.en: They celebrated their tenth wedding anniversary last week.
anniversary.zh: 上周他们庆祝了结婚十周年纪念日。

announce.en: The company will announce its new product tomorrow.
announce.zh: 公司明天将发布新产品。

annual.en: The annual meeting will be held in December.

anticipate.en: We anticipate that prices will rise next year.
anticipate.zh: 我们预计明年物价会上涨。

anxiety.en: Exam anxiety is common among students.
anxiety.zh: 考试焦虑在学生中很常见。

anxious.en: She felt anxious about the interview results.
anxious.zh: 她对面试结果感到焦虑。

apologize.en: You should apologize for being late again.
apologize.zh: 你应该为再次迟到道歉。

apparent.en: It was apparent that he knew nothing about the plan.
apparent.zh: 显然他对这个计划一无所知。

appeal.en: These pictures appeal to young people.
appeal.zh: 这些图片很吸引年轻人。

appetite.en: Exercise gives me a good appetite.

applaud.en: Please do not applaud until the performance ends.
applaud.zh: 演出结束前请不要鼓掌。

appreciate.en: I really appreciate your help with the project.
appreciate.zh: 我非常感谢你在这个项目上的帮助。

approach.en: We need a new approach to solve this problem.
approach.zh: 我们需要一个新方法来解决这个问题。

appropriate.en: Jeans are not appropriate for a formal dinner.
appropriate.zh: 牛仔裤不适合正式晚宴。

approve.en: Her parents did not approve of her decision.
approve.zh: 她的父母不赞成她的决定。

arbitrary.en: The rules seem completely arbitrary and unfair.
arbitrary.zh: 这些规则似乎完全武断且不公平。

assess.en: Teachers assess student progress every month.
assess.zh: 老师们每个月评估学生的进步。

assume.en: Do not assume that everyone agrees with you.
assume.zh: 不要想当然地认为每个人都同意你的看法。

attribute.en: Many people attribute their success to luck rather than effort.
attribute.zh: 许多人把成功归因于运气而非努力。

authentic.en: The museum displays authentic ancient coins.
authentic.zh: 博物馆展出真正的古钱币。

autonomous.en: The region became fully autonomous in 1993.

benchmark.en: This test sets the benchmark for high school English.
benchmark.zh: 这项测试为高中英语设定了基准。

benefit.en: Regular exercise can benefit both body and mind.
benefit.zh: 定期锻炼对身心都有益处。

bias.en: The report was criticized for its political bias.
bias.zh: 该报告因政治偏见而受到批评。

boost.en: A good night of sleep can boost your memory.
boost.zh: 一夜好眠能提升你的记忆力。

boundary.en: The river forms the boundary between the two countries.
boundary.zh: 这条河构成了两国的边界。

breakthrough.en: Scientists made a major breakthrough in cancer research.
breakthrough.zh: 科学家在癌症研究方面取得重大突破。

capacity.en: The stadium has a seating capacity of eighty thousand.
capacity.zh: 这座体育场可容纳八万人就座。

cease.en: The company decided to cease production of the old model.
cease.zh: 公司决定停止生产旧型号。

challenge.en: Learning a foreign language is a big challenge.
challenge.zh: 学习外语是一个巨大的挑战。

circumstance.en: We cannot control every circumstance in life.
circumstance.zh: 我们无法控制生活中的每一种情况。

collaborate.en: The two universities collaborate on environmental research.
collaborate.zh: 这两所大学在环境研究方面合作。

commodity.en: Water has become a precious commodity in dry regions.
commodity.zh: 在干旱地区，水已成为珍贵的商品。

compatible.en: This software is not compatible with older phones.
compatible.zh: 这款软件与旧手机不兼容。

compensate.en: Nothing can compensate for the loss of time.
compensate.zh: 什么都无法弥补时间的损失。

competent.en: A competent driver knows the traffic rules well.
competent.zh: 一名合格的司机非常熟悉交通规则。

comprehensive.en: The book offers a comprehensive guide to gardening.
comprehensive.zh: 这本书提供了全面的园艺指南。

compromise.en: Both sides refused to compromise on the key issue.
compromise.zh: 双方都拒绝在关键问题上妥协。

conceal.en: He tried to conceal his disappointment behind a smile.
conceal.zh: 他试图用微笑掩饰失望。

conceive.en: It is hard to conceive of life without the Internet.
conceive.zh: 很难想象没有互联网的生活。

condemn.en: All countries condemn violence of any kind.
condemn.zh: 所有国家都谴责任何形式的暴力。

confirm.en: Please confirm your reservation by phone.
confirm.zh: 请打电话确认您的预订。

consequence.en: He lost his job as a consequence of the scandal.
consequence.zh: 他因这起丑闻而丢了工作。

conservative.en: My grandfather has very conservative views on education.
conservative.zh: 我祖父在教育问题上观点非常保守。

considerable.en: The project requires a considerable amount of time.
considerable.zh: 这个项目需要相当多的时间。

controversy.en: The new law caused a heated controversy.
controversy.zh: 新法律引发了激烈的争议。

convince.en: The evidence failed to convince the jury.

cooperate.en: The two companies cooperate on green energy projects.
cooperate.zh: 这两家公司在绿色能源项目上合作。

criterion.en: Price is not the only criterion for choosing a phone.
criterion.zh: 价格不是选择手机的唯一标准。

crucial.en: Good communication is crucial to a happy marriage.
crucial.zh: 良好的沟通对幸福婚姻至关重要。

decline.en: The birth rate continues to decline in many countries.
decline.zh: 许多国家的出生率持续下降。

dedicate.en: He decided to dedicate his life to medical research.
dedicate.zh: 他决定把一生献给医学研究。

demonstrate.en: The teacher used pictures to demonstrate the idea.
demonstrate.zh: 老师用图片演示了这个想法。

distribute.en: Volunteers distribute food to the homeless every weekend.
distribute.zh: 志愿者每个周末给无家可归者分发食物。

diverse.en: New York is famous for its diverse culture.
diverse.zh: 纽约以其多元的文化闻名。

economy.en: The national economy grew by three percent this year.
economy.zh: 今年国民经济增长了百分之三。

eliminate.en: We should eliminate bad habits step by step.
eliminate.zh: 我们应该逐步消除坏习惯。

emphasis.en: Schools place great emphasis on exam results.
emphasis.zh: 学校非常重视考试成绩。

enable.en: The new software enables faster data processing.
enable.zh: 新软件使更快的数据处理成为可能。

encounter.en: Tourists may encounter heavy rain in the mountains.
encounter.zh: 游客在山区可能遇到大雨。

enhance.en: Music can enhance your learning experience.
enhance.zh: 音乐能提升你的学习体验。

enormous.en: An enormous amount of work remains to be done.

ensure.en: Please ensure that all doors are locked before leaving.
ensure.zh: 离开前请确保所有门都已锁好。

establish.en: They plan to establish a new research center.
establish.zh: 他们计划建立一个新的研究中心。

evaluate.en: Experts evaluate the safety of new medicines.
evaluate.zh: 专家评估新药的安全性。

evident.en: It was evident that she had practiced a lot.
evident.zh: 显然她进行了大量练习。

evolve.en: Companies must evolve to survive fierce competition.
evolve.zh: 公司必须不断进化才能在激烈竞争中生存。

exceed.en: Do not exceed the speed limit while driving.

facilitate.en: The new app facilitates communication between teachers and parents.
facilitate.zh: 新应用促进了教师与家长之间的沟通。

fundamental.en: Reading is a fundamental skill for every student.
fundamental.zh: 阅读是每个学生的基本技能。

generate.zh: 风力涡轮机产生清洁电力。

hypothesis.en: The experiment supports our original hypothesis.
hypothesis.zh: 实验支持了我们最初的假设。

implement.en: The school will implement new safety rules next term.
implement.zh: 学校下学期将实施新的安全规定。

inevitable.en: Change is inevitable in a fast-growing city.
inevitable.zh: 在快速发展的城市中，变化是不可避免的。

influence.en: Parents have a strong influence on their children.
influence.zh: 父母对孩子有很大影响。
